steps.command:
cd /workspace
od -A x -t x1z secrets.7z
echo '--- john binaries ---'
ls -la john/run/ | grep -Ei 'john|7z|2john' | head -40
echo '--- python modules ---'
python3 -c "import py7zr; print('py7zr', py7zr.__version__)" 2>&1
pip3 list 2>/dev/null | head -30

cd /workspace/john
ls -la run/john run/password.lst 2>&1
echo '--- 7z format in john ---'
ls run/*7z* src/*7z* 2>/dev/null
echo '--- built objects? ---'
ls run/*.o 2>/dev/null | head
echo '--- perl ---'
which perl

cd /workspace
perl john/run/7z2john.pl secrets.7z > hash.txt 2> err.txt; echo "exit=$?"
cat hash.txt
echo '--- err ---'
cat err.txt

ls -la /var/lib/apt /var/lib/dpkg 2>&1 | head -30
cat /etc/apt/sources.list 2>/dev/null; ls /etc/apt/sources.list.d 2>/dev/null
cat /etc/apt/sources.list.d/* 2>/dev/null | head -20
mkdir -p /var/lib/apt/lists/partial /var/lib/dpkg
apt-get update -qq 2>&1 | tail -5
echo "update_exit=$?"

mkdir -p /var/lib/apt/lists/partial /var/lib/dpkg /var/cache/apt/archives/partial
apt-get update -qq >/tmp/upt.log 2>&1; echo "update=$?"
tail -3 /tmp/upt.log
DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq libcompress-raw-lzma-perl p7zip-full >/tmp/inst.log 2>&1; echo "install=$?"
tail -5 /tmp/inst.log
which 7z; perl -MCompress::Raw::Lzma -e 'print "lzma ok\n"' 2>&1
cd /workspace
7z l secrets.7z 2>&1 | head -30
echo '=== 7z2john ==='
perl john/run/7z2john.pl secrets.7z > hash.txt 2>err.txt; echo "exit=$?"
cat hash.txt; cat err.txt

cd /workspace
cat > decode_header.py <<'PY'
import lzma, struct, binascii
data = open('secrets.7z','rb').read()
print('len', len(data))
print(binascii.hexlify(data[48:181]).decode())
# raw LZMA1 with props 0x5d, dict 4096, unpack 166
filt = [{'id': lzma.FILTER_LZMA1, 'dict_size': 0x1000, 'lc':3, 'lp':0, 'pb':2}]
d = lzma.LZMADecompressor(format=lzma.FORMAT_RAW, filters=filt)
out = d.decompress(data[48:181])
print('decompressed len', len(out))
print(binascii.hexlify(out).decode())
open('header.bin','wb').write(out)
print('eof', d.eof)
PY
python3 decode_header.py

set -e
mkdir -p /var/lib/apt/lists/partial /var/cache/apt/archives/partial /var/log/apt /var/lib/dpkg/info /var/lib/dpkg/updates /var/lib/dpkg/triggers /var/lib/dpkg/parts
touch /var/lib/dpkg/status /var/lib/dpkg/available
apt-get update -qq >/tmp/upt.log 2>&1 || { tail -5 /tmp/upt.log; exit 1; }
cd /tmp
apt-get download -qq libcompress-raw-lzma-perl p7zip-full >/tmp/dl.log 2>&1 || { tail -5 /tmp/dl.log; exit 1; }
ls -la /tmp/*.deb
rm -rf /workspace/opt; mkdir -p /workspace/opt
for d in /tmp/*.deb; do dpkg-deb -x "$d" /workspace/opt; done
find /workspace/opt -name 'Lzma*' -o -name '7z*' | head -20
echo '=== test perl ==='
PERL5LIB=/workspace/opt/usr/share/perl5:/workspace/opt/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/perl5/5.38 perl -MCompress::Raw::Lzma -e 'print "lzma ok\n"' 2>&1
echo '=== 7z2john ==='
cd /workspace
PERL5LIB=/workspace/opt/usr/share/perl5:/workspace/opt/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/perl5/5.38 perl john/run/7z2john.pl secrets.7z > hash.txt 2>err.txt; echo "exit=$?"
head -c 2000 hash.txt; echo; echo '--- err ---'; cat err.txt

cd /workspace
./john/run/john --list=formats 2>/dev/null | tr ',' '\n' | grep -i '^7z' ; echo "formats_grep_done"
cat > cands.txt <<'C'
password
secret
secrets
123456
12345678
7z
john
letmein
admin
archive
secret_file
secretfile
P@ssw0rd
password123
qwerty
abc123
111111
iloveyou
dragon
monkey
C
rm -f john.pot
timeout 120 ./john/run/john --format=7z --pot=john.pot --wordlist=cands.txt hash.txt 2>&1 | tail -20
echo '--- show ---'
./john/run/john --format=7z --pot=john.pot --show hash.txt 2>&1

nproc; grep -c ^processor /proc/cpuinfo; free -m | head -2
cd /workspace
wc -l john/run/password.lst
head -50 john/run/password.lst

echo '=== root dirs ==='
ls -la /
echo '=== /root ==='
ls -la /root 2>/dev/null; cat /root/.bash_history 2>/dev/null | head
echo '=== env ==='
env | sort | head -50
echo '=== recent files (2025-10-01+) outside workspace ==='
find / -xdev -newermt '2025-10-20' -type f 2>/dev/null | grep -v '^/workspace/' | head -100

echo '=== /opt ==='
find /opt -maxdepth 3 -type f | head -50
ls -la /opt /opt/*
echo '=== /usr/local/bin/agent type ==='
file /usr/local/bin/agent 2>/dev/null; strings /usr/local/bin/agent 2>/dev/null | grep -iE 'password|secret|7z|task' | head -20
echo '=== docker-ish files ==='
ls -la / | grep -iE 'docker|entry|setup|init'
find / -xdev -maxdepth 3 -iname '*task*' -o -iname '*setup*' -o -iname '*flag*' 2>/dev/null | head -30

echo '=== lost+found ==='
ls -laR /workspace/lost+found 2>&1 | head -50
echo '=== block devs ==='
lsblk 2>/dev/null; df -h /workspace
echo '=== devices ==='
ls -la /dev/vd* 2>&1
echo '=== strings vdb (workspace) grep ==='
timeout 120 strings -n 5 /dev/vdb 2>/dev/null | grep -iE '7z|secret|password|passwd|testbed|moca' | sort -u | head -60

cd /workspace
head -5000 john/run/password.lst > top5k.txt
wc -l top5k.txt
rm -f pot1.pot
timeout 500 ./john/run/john --format=7z --pot=pot1.pot --wordlist=top5k.txt hash.txt 2>&1 | tail -15
echo '--- show ---'
./john/run/john --format=7z --pot=pot1.pot --show hash.txt 2>&1

set -e
mkdir -p /var/lib/apt/lists/partial /var/cache/apt/archives/partial /var/log/apt /var/lib/dpkg/info /var/lib/dpkg/updates /var/lib/dpkg/triggers /var/lib/dpkg/parts
touch /var/lib/dpkg/status /var/lib/dpkg/available
apt-get update -qq >/tmp/upt.log 2>&1
cd /tmp
apt-get download -qq 7zip >/tmp/dl.log 2>&1 || { tail -5 /tmp/dl.log; exit 1; }
ls -la /tmp/7zip*.deb
dpkg-deb -x /tmp/7zip*.deb /workspace/opt
ls -la /workspace/opt/usr/lib/7zip/ /workspace/opt/usr/bin/7z* 2>/dev/null
cd /workspace
rm -rf extracted; mkdir extracted
/workspace/opt/usr/lib/7zip/7zz x -p1998 -oextracted secrets.7z -y 2>&1 | tail -20 || \
/workspace/opt/usr/bin/7zz x -p1998 -oextracted secrets.7z -y 2>&1 | tail -20
echo '=== files ==='
find extracted -type f -exec ls -la {} \;
echo '=== content ==='
for f in $(find extracted -type f); do echo "--- $f ---"; cat "$f"; echo; done

cd /workspace
ls -la secret* extracted 2>&1
LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/workspace/opt/usr/lib/7zip /workspace/opt/usr/lib/7zip/7z x -p1998 -o/workspace/extracted /workspace/secrets.7z -y 2>&1 | tail -25
echo "exit=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
echo '=== files ==='
find /workspace/extracted -type f -exec ls -la {} \;
echo '=== content ==='
find /workspace/extracted -type f -exec sh -c 'echo "--- $1 ---"; cat "$1"; echo' _ {} \;

sbx put solution.txt <<'EOF'
honeybear
EOF
sbx run <<'EOF'
ls -la /app/solution.txt
cat /app/solution.txt
od -c /app/solution.txt
EOF
